THIS MFA FILED U/S. 173(1) OF MV ACT, PRAYING TO MODIFY THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED- 04.04.2017 PASSED BY THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC AT JEWARGI IN MVC NO.856/2014 AND ETC.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This is petitioners' appeal filed under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (for short 'the Act')
seeking enhancement of compensation granted for the death of Mittesab (deceased for short), in a motor vehicles accident dated 11.04.2014 2.
For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to by their rank before the Tribunal.
3. Petitioners are the wife, children and father of deceased.
It is the case of petitioners that on 11.04.2014 deceased and other villagers were travelling in NEKRTC bus bearing Reg.No.KA-34-F-1023 from Jevargi to their native place Hipparaga (SN).
Deceased was sitting in the rear seat near the back side door which was not fitted with shutters.

At about 7:45 p.m. the driver of the bus drove the same in a rash or negligent manner and took turn towards Koodi cross,
as a result of which deceased thrown out of the bus and sustained injuries. During treatment he died on 17.04.2014.
As the owner and internal insurer of the offending vehicle, respondent is liable to pay the compensation.

4. Respondent has filed written statement denying the averments regarding the age, occupation,
income of the deceased, petitioners were dependent on him and that accident occurred due to rash or negligent driving of the offending vehicle.

Since deceased was standing in the door negligently he fell down and he sustained injuries and to enable the petitioners to claim compensation police have registered criminal case against the driver of the offending vehicle and prays to dismiss the petition.

9. Respondent has not challenged the impugned judgment and award.
10. During the course of argument, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that 50% income is required to be added towards future prospects.
The compensation granted on the head loss of consortium is on the lower side and prays to allow the appeal.
11. On the other hand, learned counsel for respondent supported the impugned judgment and award and sought for dismissal of the appeal.

12. Heard arguments and perused the records.
13.

Having regard to the fact that the respondent has not challenged the impugned judgment and award, the findings of the Tribunal that the accident occurred due to the rash or negligent driving by the driver of the offending vehicle and in the said accident, Mittesab died due to the injuries sustained in the said accident has attained finality.
14. Based on the evidence placed on record the Tribunal has correctly taken the age of the deceased as 39 years and as such multiplier 15 considered by the Tribunal is correct.
Since deceased was a government employee based on pay slip at Ex.P6 the Tribunal has correctly taken his income at Rs.23,025/-.
